name: 94521 · Concord, CA
findings: ZIP 94521 (Concord) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94521 (Concord) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94521 (Concord) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
